brief.title: Design analysis
brief.intro: This is how the AI understood the style of your material:

progress.analyzing: The AI is analysing your material …
progress.generating: The AI is designing your theme – this takes up to two minutes …
progress.editing: The AI is revising your theme …

print.aiNoPermission: You need the permission for AI features.
print.templatesHint: Ready-made table cards, tents and posters – customise and print.
print.filesHint: Upload your menu, a flyer or your old table card – the AI adopts your style.
print.promptHint: Describe the card you want in your own words – voice works too.
print.blankHint: A simple card as a starting point for your own code.
print.busy: The AI is already working on a design – please wait a moment.
print.importWrongKind: This file is a menu theme, not a print design. Import it under “Design”.
print.importTooLarge: The file is too large (max. 6 MB).
print.doneHint: You'll find it among your print designs. In the studio you can show or hide elements, adjust texts and use it as your print design.
print.runningPill: AI is designing your print design · {seconds} s
print.templatesDescription: Pick a template – it is copied into your own print designs, where you can adjust it freely.
print.templatesFailed: The templates could not be loaded.
print.templateUsed: “{name}” was added to your print designs
print.filesDialogDescription: Upload a PDF or photos of your menu, a flyer, your current table card or your logo. The AI adopts colours, fonts and style – the QR code is always designed to scan reliably.
print.notesHint: What should be on the card, what should change?
print.notesPlaceholder: e.g. include the Wi-Fi details, logo at the top, a bit more modern than the old card
print.promptDialogDescription: Describe the mood, colours and what should be on the card. We insert the table number and QR code for every table automatically.
print.promptPlaceholder: e.g. Elegant black table card with a golden table number, our Wi-Fi at the bottom
print.voiceHint: Or just say it – in any language.
print.example_elegant: Elegant black table card with a golden table number
print.example_cafePoster: Cheerful A4 café poster for the shop window
print.example_tent: Beer-garden style table tent with Wi-Fi on the back
print.example_minimal: Minimalist card with lots of white space and a big number
print.example_kids: Colourful, playful card for a family restaurant
print.referencesHint: Images whose style the AI should pick up – e.g. your logo or your interior.
print.blankDialogDescription: A simple card with table number, QR code and all important elements – ideal for continuing in code yourself.
